description_en: Retrieves the list of parameters for a GPU cluster
name: GetGpuClusterArgsOptions

parameters.help_en:
Query cluster machine list scenario: Set the retrieval type to comm_instance_id_list or instance_id_list. comm_instance_id_list: Retrieves only the list of machines in the specified cluster that participate in collective communication. instance_id_list: Retrieves the list of all machines in the specified cluster.
Query cluster AI task list scenario: Set the retrieval type to comm_task_id_list or task_id_list. comm_task_id_list: Retrieves only the list of tasks in the specified cluster that involve collective communication. task_id_list: Retrieves the list of all tasks in the specified cluster.
Query cluster AI job pod list scenario: Set the retrieval type to comm_pod_list or pod_list. comm_pod_list: Retrieves only the list of pods in the specified cluster that participate in collective communication. pod_list: Retrieves the list of all pods in the specified cluster.
Query collective communication topology scenario: communication: Retrieves all communication group IDs. channel: Retrieves the channel list under the specified communication group ID. topoType: Retrieves the topology type under the specified channel of the specified communication group ID
parameters.help_zh:
1、查询集群机器列表场景
指定获取类型，设置为comm_instance_id_list或者
instance_id_list
comm_instance_id_list：只会获取指定集群中，有参与集合通信的机器列表
instance_id_list：是获取指定集群的所有机器列表

2、查询集群AI任务列表场景
指定获取类型，设置为comm_task_id_list或者
task_id_list
comm_task_id_list：只会获取指定集群中，有集合通信的任务列表
task_id_list：是获取指定集群的所有任务列表

3、查询集群AI作业pod列表
指定获取类型，设置为comm_pod_list或者
pod_list
comm_pod_list：只会获取指定集群中，有参与集合通信的pod列表
pod_list：是获取指定集群的所有pod列表

4、查询集合通信拓扑场景
communication：获取所有通信组ID
channel：获取指定通信组ID下的通道列表
topoType： 获取指定通信组ID下的指定通道下的拓扑类型
parameters.name: filter_type

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions, which is a JSON object. The cluster_id field is required. Other filter conditions support the following values:
instance_id_list
comm_instance_id_list
pod_list
comm_pod_list
communication
task_id_list
comm_task_id_list
channel
topoType
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件，json对象。“cluster_id”必须要包含，其他过了条件，支持如下：
instance_id_list
comm_instance_id_list
pod_list
comm_pod_list
communication
task_id_list
comm_task_id_list
channel
topoType
parameters.name: filter_values

code.description_en: The response code, which is Success or Sysom.ServerError

data.description_en: The result of the parameter retrieval

message.description_en: The error message returned when the code is not Success
message.example: some error msg while fail，“” if success

total.description_en: The total number of returned items
